messages:
ana (devex): Quick heads-up: new sample app fails only when deployed to edge: runtime error 'Unexpected token export' from a dependency. local pnpm dev is fine. anyone seen a pnpm + exports + edge optimizer mismatch?
leo (eng-runtime): yep. usually exports/conditional entries missing or wildcard exports pointing at cjs. bundler picks a file that isn't ESM for edge.
toni (pkg): our package.json had a dumb shortcut: "./*": "./lib/cjs/*" so all subpaths resolve to CJS. will that break import-based resolvers?
nina (ts): it will. TS in a workspace can also resolve different paths due to symlinks. editors may be fine but the edge optimizer (which treats installs from registry) uses exports to choose the entry.
nana (devex): typo, I meant ana :)
nana (devex): pasted minimal snippet: { "exports": { "./*": "./lib/cjs/*", ".": "./lib/cjs/index.js" }, "types": "types/index.d.ts" }
leo (eng-runtime): yep there it is. change root to conditional import/require and remove wildcard. something like: { ".": { "import": "./lib/esm/index.js", "require": "./lib/cjs/index.js" }, "./package.json": "./package.json" }
toni (pkg): we actually only build esm for new code, cjs is legacy. but CI publish omitted lib/esm from the tarball because of an accidental npmignore. local pnpm link hid it.
nina (ts): classic. add a publish verification step: tar -tf <tgz> | rg 'lib/esm' and fail if missing. also ensure "types" points to the published d.ts next to the exported entry, e.g. lib/esm/index.d.ts.
leo (eng-runtime): app-side mitigations: in webpack/rollup set mainFields: ['exports','module','main'] and ensure optimizer target is ESM for edge platforms. Vercel SWC bundler tends to follow exports but if exports is misleading it will fall back.
toni (pkg): republished with proper exports and included esm build. publish-bot: published pkg@1.2.7 (build 712)
publish-bot: npm publish succeeded for pkg@1.2.7 :package: (sha: abc123)
ana (devex): redeployed sample to edge and it's green now. adding PR checklist: 1) esm present in tarball, 2) conditional exports, 3) types adjacent to esm entry, 4) test install-from-registry in CI.
nina (ts): for monorepos, extra note: set "preserveSymlinks": true in Node-based tooling if you rely on symlink semantics, but prefer publishing correct exports.
leo (eng-runtime): and if someone hits resolution errors with pnpm hoist layout, try public-hoist-pattern or temporary shamefully-hoist, but those are bandaids. fix the package exports instead.
toni (pkg): adding prepublish-check and a small script to validate exports and types. thanks all. :pray:
